# CityGML

**Maintainer ecosystem:** Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) Standard  
**Version targeted:** 2.0 (LOD 2.0 building geometry in GML3)  
**Role in ARCA:** XML-based 3D city model exchange format export

ARCA produces CityGML (`building.gml`) compliant with OGC CityGML 2.0 schemas (`bldg:Building`, `bldg:lod2Solid` / `gml:Solid` / `gml:CompositeSurface`), writing coordinates directly via disk streaming and declaring standard XML namespaces (core, bldg, gml, xal, xlink, xsi).

ARCA does not claim ownership of the CityGML standard or formal OGC compliance certification.
